findings.title: String `<<` mutates discourse_host, corrupting the hostname
findings.body: `discourse_host.ends_with?("." << website_host)` is wrong for two reasons. First, `"." << website_host` builds a string that is then used only for the check, so it works, but if the frozen-string literal magic comment is ever enabled it will raise. Second, the logic is fragile: the check relies on the string-building side effect rather than an explicit `".#{website_host}"`. Rewrite it with interpolation so the intent is clear and the code is safe under frozen string literals.

findings.title: include_website_name is missing the trailing '?' so it is never called
findings.body: ActiveModel::Serializers only honors `include_<attr>?` methods. `include_website_name` without the question mark is dead code. As a result `website_name` is always serialized, including when the website is blank or when `untrusted_attributes` hides `website` for TL0 users viewed by anonymous. That leaks the website host for TL0 users and emits `website_name: nil` when there is no website. Rename it to `include_website_name?`, and also add `website_name` to `untrusted_attributes`.

findings.title: URI parsing is repeated and the path may be empty or have no scheme
findings.body: `URI(website.to_s)` is parsed up to three times per call. Websites saved without a scheme, e.g. `example.com/user`, have a nil host. That makes `website_name` nil, and since the old client-side `split("/")[2]` also returned nothing for them, the behavior stays the same but is now untested. Also, appending the full path for same-domain sites will include trailing slashes (`example.com/`) and long paths. Parse once into a local variable and handle the empty-path case.

findings.title: Sibling-subdomain heuristic is incorrect
findings.body: The branch compares the label count and everything after the first label. This makes `www.example.com` match `forum.example.com`, but it also matches unrelated multi-part TLDs such as `a.co.uk` and `b.co.uk`, which have the same label count and the same suffix `co.uk`. It also fails when the website host and the instance host have different depths. The branch comment says "www.example.com == forum.example.com", but the spec has no test for it. Add tests and use a more robust domain comparison.

findings.title: Missing tests for sibling-subdomain, blank-website and anonymous TL0 cases
findings.body: The specs cover three branches, but not the sibling-subdomain branch (www.example.com vs forum.example.com), not an unparseable or blank website, and not that `website_name` is hidden for the anonymous TL0 user (the untrusted attributes list in the spec does not include it).
